releases.notes:
Everything your appliance runs now updates together.

This release brings Home Assistant to 2026.9.3 and every ASCIA component to its newest version in
the same step. An update now lands completely or not at all: if any part fails to come up, the
appliance returns on its own to exactly where it was. Rolling back by hand now takes every part back
too, keeping your settings, your dashboard and your history.

A sudden power cut in the middle of an update can no longer cause a good update to be undone, and
the account you create when you first set the appliance up now survives a power cut straight after.
